description: Definition of the two fitted pathway coordinates in SI E.3.
cluster_input: Unit direction vectors of standardized reference-subtracted pathways
centroid_normalization: Each fitted centroid is normalized to unit length before ordering
keyword_match: Case-sensitive substring search in the supplied uppercase pathway names
summary: Arithmetic mean of normalized-centroid coordinates over the selected pathways
radius: L2 norm of the standardized reference-subtracted pathway vector d
orientation: (d/r) dot (m1-m3), with zero orientation at r=0
score_ties: Swap only for strict inequality; equal summaries retain KMeans order under the fixed seed
reference_designs: Main analysis uses draw-specific source assets; the frozen-reference study uses compound-weighted quantiles and clustering, with the same ordering and selected indices.
label_use: No toxicity labels in clustering or within-tail ordering. Source-compound draw stratification and supervised model fitting are label-dependent.
interpretation: A specified source-relative direction contrast alongside magnitude; no claim of optimal prototype choice or toxic/nontoxic cluster identity.
